Custom CRM extensions for independent advisors

Make your Wealthbox or Redtail fit your practice.

Your CRM does what it was built to do. We build the layer above it: digital intake, signed-PDF generation, custodian paperwork automation and client portals that turn your CRM into the onboarding system your firm actually needs.

Read the TFS case study
What we build

Forms, portals, automations, deployments.

Four buckets. Everything we ship for advisory firms sits inside one of them.

  1. FORMS

    Digital intake and signed PDFs

    New-client intake forms with conditional logic, document upload and e-signature. Custodian paperwork is pre-filled and signed in one flow. Forms write directly to your CRM, so nothing is re-typed and fewer applications come back not in good order.

  2. PORTALS

    Branded client portals

    Secure document vaults, signed-agreement archives, quarterly review prep and beneficiary updates, branded to your firm. Clients sign in once and see what matters in one place.

  3. AUTOMATIONS

    CRM workflow automation

    Reminder sequences, household relationship sync, risk-tolerance scoring and IPS draft generation, built on your CRM's API. It extends what you bought. It does not replace it.

  4. DEPLOYMENTS

    Implementation and ongoing care

    We handle the build, the deployment, the training and the fixes. You keep a direct line to the person who wrote the code, with no ticket queue in between.

Scope

Three ways firms work with us.

Each is scoped to your firm and your CRM. You get a written scope and quote before any build starts.

  1. 01

    Onboarding audit

    A recorded walkthrough of your current new-client onboarding and a written report on the highest-value fixes for your firm's stack.

  2. 02

    Intake build

    A digital intake form and one CRM sync: document upload, e-signature, conditional logic, automatic CRM record creation and custodian form pre-fill.

  3. 03

    Full onboarding system

    The full Team Financial Strategies scope: intake, CRM sync, contract auto-population, signed-PDF generation, reminder sequences and financial-profile sync.

Security posture

What happens to client PII?

Security and data handling

MonkFlow is a workflow layer, not a data store. Client information moves directly into your CRM, and we do not persist PII or financial data on our infrastructure. Data is protected with TLS in transit and AES-256 encryption at rest.

We will walk your chief compliance officer through the architecture on request.
